item.title: Men’s Basketball Struggles Offensively in Loss to Seattle
item.description: Pepperdine Men's Basketball battled the Seattle Redhawks on Feb. 25 at Firestone Fieldhouse for the second time this season, falling 87-80. The Waves moves to 8-22 on the season, falling to last place in the West Coast Conference, setting them up for a tough West Coast Conference tournament March 5-10. The post Men’s Basketball Struggles Offensively in Loss to Seattle appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: ‘From Loss to Light’: Arik Housley Discusses Finding Resilience in Grief at 2026 RISE Summit
item.description: Pepperdine hosted Arik Housley (‘96), father of Pepperdine student Alaina, who was killed in the mass shooting at Borderline Bar & Grill in 2018. Housley spoke at the W. David Baird Distinguished Lecture Series and the annual RISE Summit on Feb 20. The post ‘From Loss to Light’: Arik Housley Discusses Finding Resilience in Grief at 2026 RISE Summit appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Pepperdine Turning Point USA Chapter Turns Heads on Campus
item.description: Since the vigil for Charlie Kirk, Pepperdine's Turning Point USA chapter has maintained a visible presence on campus. Their Valentine's grams sparked controversy and ignited a larger debate on the limits of free speech. The post Pepperdine Turning Point USA Chapter Turns Heads on Campus appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Veritas Forum Teaches Hospitality in a Polarized Political Climate
item.description: The 2026 Veritas Forum taught attendees what it means to love others with different beliefs. Panelists Matthew Kaemingk and Amanda Rizkallah answered questions about political polarization and practicing Christian hospitality. The post Veritas Forum Teaches Hospitality in a Polarized Political Climate appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.description: For students returning from a semester abroad, Malibu hits differently the second time around. With new class schedules and routines, many have undergone personal change. item.title: Pepperdine Athletics Officially Hires Swim/Dive Head Coach
item.description: Pepperdine's Swim/Dive program was rocked when Athletics announced Head Coach Ellie Monobe was leaving midseason to pursue a coaching opportunity at Saint Mary's College. The Waves found comfort in their interim head coach, Dan Marella, who has officially been named as the program's next leader, according to Pepperdine Athletics. The post Pepperdine Athletics Officially Hires Swim/Dive Head Coach appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Remembering the Sound of Forgotten Music
item.description: As students spend hours listening to the same playlists on repeat it’s difficult to imagine what may lie beyond their typical music choice. Genres such as blues, trip-hop and punk rock have remained backstage for far too long. The post Remembering the Sound of Forgotten Music appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.description: The Perspectives section exists to share a diverse array of opinions, though it has recently reflected many left-leaning perspectives. item.title: Good News: Life is a Mosaic of Love
item.description: Attending Pepperdine as an out-of-state student, coupled with processing the approach of graduation, led Copy Chief Faith Siegel to realize the extent to which her loved ones are scattered. Siegel reflects on this dispersal and emphasizes the unique beauty she finds in loving so abundantly. The post Good News: Life is a Mosaic of Love appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.
